sub_sector.value: HVAC equipment; detection and measurement systems

manufacturing_type.detail: Manufactures cooling towers, fans and boilers and builds modular and fully custom air handling units.

production_model.detail: Builds fully custom air handling units and customized electric heating solutions.

product_complexity.detail: Highly engineered HVAC equipment and specialized underground location, inspection, fare collection, navigation and communications systems.

production_role.detail: Supplies finished HVAC equipment, detection and measurement systems, and components such as coils and OEM aftermarket parts.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves industrial facilities, commercial and residential buildings, healthcare facilities, marine and military customers, energy utilities and data centers.

notes: The evidence supports make-to-order production for custom equipment, while make-to-stock production remains unverified.
